Calibrates the NVML covariate reference operating point via a READ-ONLY NVML telemetry sweep on the local RTX 3090 Ti while a sustained user-space CUDA matmul holds the card at a steady-state active operating point. Samples SM clock / temperature / power / mem clock / throttle reasons (read-only getters ONLY: nvmlDeviceGetClockInfo / GetTemperature / GetPowerUsage / GetCurrentClocksThrottleReasons; NO clock-lock, persistence, power, MIG, or compute-mode mutation per CLAUDE.md Rule 2). Accepts active, plausible, non-hardware-faulted samples (SW thermal slowdown is the normal Ampere boost equilibrium, not a rejection); the reference per field is the median of accepted samples. Writes `data/local_labels/nvml_reference_operating_point_sm_86.json` (provenance: device, driver, n_accepted/n_rejected, rejection reasons, sw_thermal_active_fraction). sm_86-only: fails closed when the detected device is not an RTX 3090 Ti. Exit 3 (no write) on a host without pynvml/torch so an offline/CI host never overwrites the committed artifact. No NCU; not CUPTI.

Read-only NVML SHORT-BURST anchor calibrator. Drives a DUTY-CYCLED FP32-FMA pulse-train spin (built with nvcc, no torch; ~20% duty so the die stays cool at full boost instead of reheating into the 90C sustained-throttle regime) in a background process and samples NVML SM clock / temp / power / throttle read-only via pynvml DURING the active windows. Accepts only cool (temp <= the short-burst ceiling, well under 90C), active (clock above the idle floor, below NVML max), plausible-power samples that are not HW-fault/power-cap throttled; the benign Ampere SW_THERMAL_SLOWDOWN boost bit is recorded for provenance (NOT a rejection — on Ampere it is set continuously under load). The TEMPERATURE ceiling, not the throttle bitmask, is the regime discriminator. Emits data/local_labels/nvml_short_burst_anchor_sm_86.json with anchor_regime=short_burst (~1.89 GHz), the operating point a short kernel actually runs at, vs the sustained ~1350 MHz anchor. Rule 2: read-only NVML getters only, no clock-lock/persistence/power/MIG mutation. No NCU. pynvml is a live-capture-only dependency (uv --with pynvml), not in requirements.txt. sm_86 only; fails closed on a non-3090-Ti device.

Filename is `sass_confirm.py` (not a generic `confirm.py`) to avoid module-name collision under the sys.path-insertion sibling-import idiom per BL-20260505-tools-subdir-module-name-collision.
